title: Umbrella with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- umbrella canopy: bright red dome with scalloped bottom -->
  <path d='M10 55 Q50 8 90 55 Q82 47 74 55 Q66 47 58 55 Q50 47 42 55 Q34 47 26 55 Q18 47 10 55 Z' fill='#FF3B3B'/>
  <!-- canopy highlight panels -->
  <path d='M20 51 Q30 26 50 20 Q36 28 30 51 Q24 44 20 51 Z' fill='#FF7B7B'/>
  <path d='M52 20 Q70 26 79 51 Q74 44 68 51 Q62 30 52 20 Z' fill='#FF6060'/>
  <!-- scallop separators in a lighter red -->
  <path d='M42 55 L42 34' stroke='#FF9B9B' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M26 55 L26 38' stroke='#FF9B9B' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M58 55 L58 38' stroke='#FF9B9B' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M74 55 L74 42' stroke='#FF9B9B' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M50 50 L50 22' stroke='#FFD0D0' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- top knob -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='4' fill='#FFD23F'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='2' fill='#FFE99A'/>
  <!-- shaft -->
  <rect x='47.5' y='55' width='5' height='30' rx='2.5' fill='#FFD23F'/>
  <rect x='48.5' y='55' width='2' height='30' fill='#FFE99A'/>
  <!-- handle: J curve -->
  <path d='M50 85 Q50 94 41 94 Q33 94 33 86' stroke='#FFD23F' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 85 Q50 94 41 94 Q34 94 34 87' stroke='#FFE99A' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- smiling face on canopy center -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='38' r='3' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='38' r='3' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='38.5' r='1.5' fill='#7A1010'/>
  <circle cx='57.5' cy='38.5' r='1.5' fill='#7A1010'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 45 Q50 53 60 45' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='44' r='3' fill='#FF9B9B' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='44' r='3' fill='#FF9B9B' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- little raindrops beside umbrella -->
  <path d='M15 68 Q15 72 12 72 Q9 72 9 68 Q12 62 15 68 Z' fill='#5BC8FF'/>
  <path d='M87 66 Q87 70 84 70 Q81 70 81 66 Q84 60 87 66 Z' fill='#5BC8FF'/>
  <path d='M82 78 Q82 81 80 81 Q78 81 78 78 Q80 74 82 78 Z' fill='#8ADDFF'/>
  <path d='M18 80 Q18 83 16 83 Q14 83 14 80 Q16 76 18 80 Z' fill='#8ADDFF'/>
</svg>
